User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Learn & Shop platform.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the user.

profilePicture.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

dateJoined.description: The date and time the user joined the platform.

userId.description: The ID of the user this address belongs to.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the user's default address.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a vendor on the Learn & Shop platform.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity. (Relationship: Vendor 1:1 User)

businessName.description: The business name of the vendor.

description.description: A description of the vendor's business.

contactEmail.description: The contact email for the vendor.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product listed on the platform.

vendorId.description: Reference to the Vendor entity. (Relationship: Vendor 1:N Product)

stockQuantity.description: The number of units currently in stock.

Course.title: Course
Course.description: Represents a course offered on the platform.

vendorId.description: Reference to the Vendor entity. (Relationship: Vendor 1:N Course)

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents an order placed by a user.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity. (Relationship: User 1:N Order)

orderDate.description: The date the order was placed.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the order.

status.description: The current status of the order (e.g., pending, processing, shipped, delivered).

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents an item within an order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order item.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order entity. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

productId.description: Reference to the Product entity. (Relationship: Product 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the product in the order item.

price.description: The price of the product at the time of the order.

Enrollment.title: Enrollment
Enrollment.description: Represents a user's enrollment in a course.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity. (Relationship: User 1:N Enrollment)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course entity. (Relationship: Course 1:N Enrollment)

enrollmentDate.description: The date the user enrolled in the course.

progress.description: The user's progress in the course (e.g., percentage completed).

Recommendation.title: Recommendation
Recommendation.description: Represents a product or course recommendation for a user.

userId.description: Reference to the User entity. (Relationship: User 1:N Recommendation)

productId.description: Reference to the Product entity. (Relationship: Product 1:N Recommendation)

courseId.description: Reference to the Course entity. (Relationship: Course 1:N Recommendation)

recommendationDate.description: The date the recommendation was generated.

algorithmUsed.description: The algorithm used to generate the recommendation.

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: Represents a lesson within a course.

courseId.description: Reference to the Course entity. (Relationship: Course 1:N Lesson)

content.description: The content of the lesson (e.g., text, video URL).

order.description: The order of the lesson within the course.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a user review for a product or course.

userId.description: Reference to the User who wrote the review.

userName.description: The name of the user who wrote the review.

itemId.description: The ID of the product or course being reviewed.

itemName.description: The name of the item being reviewed.

comment.description: The text content of the review.

createdAt.description: The date the review was submitted.

WishlistItem.title: WishlistItem
WishlistItem.description: Represents an item on a user's wishlist.

id.description: Unique identifier for the wishlist item (often the product/course ID).

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns the wishlist.

itemId.description: The ID of the product or course.

addedAt.description: The date the item was added to the wishlist.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the Learn & Shop platform, focusing on secure and scalable data access for users, vendors, products, courses, orders, and related entities. It emphasizes Authorization Independence (CRITICAL) through denormalization of authorization data, DBAC (Database-Based Access Control), QAPs (Rules are not Filters), and clarity for debugging.

**Authorization Independence and QAPs:**

*   **Vendors, Products, Courses:** Vendor ID is included directly within Product and Course documents, enabling rules to validate vendor ownership without requiring `get()` calls, thus achieving Authorization Independence. This also enables secure `list` operations, as rules can filter based on the denormalized `vendorId`.
*   **Orders, OrderItems:** User ID is included directly within Order documents, enabling rules to validate user ownership. OrderItems are stored as a subcollection to the Order document.
*   **Enrollments:** User ID is included directly within Enrollment documents, enabling rules to validate user ownership.
*   **Recommendations:** User ID is included directly within Recommendation documents, enabling rules to validate user ownership.
*   **Lessons:** Course ID is included directly within Lesson documents, enabling rules to validate course ownership.
**Reviews:** Reviews for products and courses are stored in subcollections under their respective items. This allows for easy querying of all reviews for a specific item. The rules allow public read access but restrict writes to authenticated users who have purchased the item.

**Structural Segregation:**

*   User-specific data (Orders, Enrollments, Recommendations, Wishlist, Addresses) is stored under the `/users/{userId}` path, ensuring that only the owning user or authorized roles can access it.
*   Vendor data is now in a top-level `/vendors` collection to simplify rules and queries.
*   **Q&A Structure**: A top-level `/questions` collection is used to store all questions. This allows for efficient querying of all questions for a given item (`where('itemId', '==', ...)`). Answers are a subcollection under each question, which is a natural 1-to-many relationship.

**Access Modeling:**

*   Path-Based Ownership: The `/vendors/{vendorId}` pattern provides clear ownership semantics. Similarly, `/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}`, `/users/{userId}/enrollments/{enrollmentId}`, `/users/{userId}/recommendations/{recommendationId}`, and `/users/{userId}/wishlist/{wishlistItemId}` follow this pattern.

**Data Clarity and Predictability:**

*   Entity relationships are explicitly defined through ID references (e.g., `productId` in `OrderItem`, `vendorId` in `Product` and `Course`).
*   Consistent naming conventions are used (e.g., `userId`, `vendorId`, `courseId`) to improve readability and maintainability.
